newsitem.title: HUNGARY: MOL subscription may be ended on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: MOL subscription may be ended on Wednesday.

text.p: Creditanstalt Securities is likely to decide later on Wednesday if it closes a domestic offer of maximum four percent of the shares of oil and gas company MOL, the Hungarian news agency MTI said.
Creditanstalt, lead manager of the offering, was quoted by MTI on Wednesday as saying that the decision was likely to be made by 1800 GMT (2000 local time).
Creditanstalt denied Hungarian radio reports which said the decision on closing the offering on Wednesday had already been made.
The domestic offering began on Monday and it can be closed after three days in case of oversubscription.
According to media reports, the subscription places have been crowded with small investors since Monday.
MOL closed at 3,420 forints on the Budapest Stock Exchange on Wednesday, down 30 forints. The subscription price for the domestic offering is 2,970 forints.
